recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man with light stubble and textured hair, wearing a dark blue micro-polka dot shirt, set against a dark, desaturated vintage map background. The composition features a right-aligned typographic stack with varying weights and widths.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed at the viewer to establish connection
Contrast between the detailed pattern of the shirt and the subtle texture of the map
Typographic alignment flush-right against the subject's head
Warm skin tones against a cool, dark background palette
coreInvariants: Vintage cartographic texture in the background
Vignetted edges focusing light on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium-close-up crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright, bold typography in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the primary text, then down through the secondary and tertiary text layers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left and right corners provide breathing room for the background texture and text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal tones in the shirt and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm beige and tan skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light grey and muted lavender for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value contrast on the face and text elements.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earthy, desaturated blues and greys

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the top tier
Extremely condensed and elongated proportions for the middle tier
Standard width with increased letter spacing for the bottom tier
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning on the condensed middle tier
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting widths (Wide vs. Ultra-Condensed) within the same sans-serif family or style.

preserve: Extreme vertical elongation of the middle text

candidateDirections.reason: For the wide, geometric top tier.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium-shot portrait of a man with short textured hair and stubble, wearing a navy blue shirt with tiny white polka dots. The background should be a dark, desaturated vintage map with visible grid lines and faded text. Lighting should be soft on the face with a heavy vignette around the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of uppercase text in the top right corner, flush-right. Line 1: Wide geometric sans-serif in light grey. Line 2: Ultra-condensed, vertically stretched sans-serif in light grey. Line 3: Standard width sans-serif with wide tracking in muted lavender.

verificationChecks: Is the middle text line significantly taller and narrower than the others?
Is the background a faded map texture?
Does the subject have a direct gaze?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Verify the map texture doesn't distract from the face
Ensure the polka dot pattern is sharp and not blurred
Confirm the color palette remains desaturated and moody
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, thematic background with a direct-gaze portrait and a right-aligned, multi-width sans-serif typographic stack.
